This lawn was almost ruined… so I decided to fix it completely on my own
In this video, I take you through my DIY lawn transformation journey — from cutting dry grass to seeding and watering, step by step. No professional help, just a simple home project to bring this backyard back to life.
If you’ve ever struggled with patchy grass or wanted to fix your lawn yourself, this video will give you a real idea of what works (and what doesn’t).
What you’ll see in this video:
• Lawn cutting and cleanup
• Grass seeding process
• Watering routine
• Before vs after transformation
